components.current_full_image_evidence: The three-character 山野集 title forms one broad irregular object through unequal glyph mass, carved counters, selective missing strokes and controlled speckled erosion. It is the first read and bridges language, landscape metaphor and image occupancy.
components.validation_requirement: TYPOGRAPHY_REBIND with new locked copy, human character-correctness review and non-copy review

components.current_full_image_evidence: The source visibly separates dominant display identity, quieter claim/support information and tertiary expressive/ownership layers by scale, contrast and vertical register.
components.validation_requirement: Aspect and composition variation with no duplicated title and independent human hierarchy review

components.current_full_image_evidence: The light display object remains legible inside a spatially complex dark photographic field; smaller beige and white support layers use quieter local pockets and lower authority.
components.source_region: central, top and footer information zones
components.validation_requirement: Full-image CONTENT_SWAP and PALETTE_SHIFT tests with measured local legibility and realism

components.current_full_image_evidence: Four compact two-line uppercase claim groups create a sparse top cadence and help stabilize the page width without competing with the title.
components.validation_requirement: Compare omission, reduced count and truthful replacement copy without hierarchy collapse

components.current_full_image_evidence: A warm handwritten slogan introduces a slower, expressive third read distinct from the constructed title and clean functional text.
components.validation_requirement: Test omission and a newly authored/approved voice asset; reject fake-calligraphy substitution

components.current_full_image_evidence: A limited warm line crosses and loops around the title, visually links the left badge and title cluster, and shares color with the handwritten voice.
components.validation_requirement: MOTIF_REBIND comparison against omission; it passes only if the new path has subject-derived semantic work rather than decorative scribble

components.current_full_image_evidence: The vertical badge supplies a compact warm counterweight at the left edge of the broad display mass.
components.validation_requirement: Test a truthful replacement mark or equivalent counterweight; badge form itself is not required

components.current_full_image_evidence: The centered WANCE lockup and small edge labels close the long vertical composition and stabilize the lower edge.
components.validation_requirement: Use only new brand-owned production assets; test whether an equivalent peripheral closure is needed

historical_evidence_correction.issue: Historical typography evidence used the phrase 'four glyphs' while the literal title 山野集 contains three Chinese characters.
historical_evidence_correction.resolution: Historical blobs remain immutable; this full-image grammar records the direct-visible three-character title and does not propagate the count error.
